# Dragoon's Town v0.26

Develop each district and build permanent landmarks across your regional empire. Existing progress and the current economy remain compatible.

- Three optional one-time contracts per district reward growing both ventures to 1, 25 and 100 locations. Preview civic-supply rewards and claim at your own pace, with no deadlines. Existing holdings qualify.
- Build Harbor Observatory, Regional Archives and Botanical Conservatory after meeting regional requirements. Review cash and civic-supply costs first. These permanent landmarks are cosmetic; display an owned landmark or hide it for free.
- Find contracts in Progress → Goals & contracts and landmarks in Progress → Districts & regions. Illustrated icons match the town, and new guide lessons explain both systems.
- Save migration adds only the new project record. Existing cash, businesses, estates, vehicles, market holdings, prestige and repeatable contract overflow remain protected. New progress survives prestige and travels with your game backup.

Business prices, income formulas, milestone thresholds and prestige rules remain unchanged. Optional landmark construction is manual and excluded from global MAX. No real payments, ads or paid servers were added.

Android players: gear → App updates → Check now, then install over the existing app without uninstalling. Browser players: refresh the same game link.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex. Physical Thor/Android 13 installation and sustained performance remain separate playtests.
